result:
Task complete. Summary:

- Built `scripts/notify-owner.py` — sends real Owner email via Resend API, rate-limited to 1/hour per issue signature (content-hash state file). Deployed live at `/opt/veridian/scripts/notify-owner.py`, and confirmed working with a real send (message id `d08a0b6e-35a4-4c70-a0fa-bef7e26be6a9`; had to add a `User-Agent` header since Resend/Cloudflare blocks Python's bare urllib default).
- Wired it into `/opt/veridian/scripts/health-check-15min.py`: calls it for genuinely new anomalies (ATTENTION.md write untouched) and escalates any task stuck at `status=blocked` across two consecutive 15-min cycles, exactly once per continuous stretch.
- Caught and fixed a real spam risk before shipping: the live task pool has 229 pre-existing blocked tasks, all stale (days old, none checkpointed recently) — without a recency filter, first activation would've fired ~229 emails at once. Added a >2h checkpoint-age filter so only genuinely live blocked tasks escalate.
- Since `/opt/veridian/scripts`/`ai-os` aren't git-tracked (server-local ops dirs), committed and pushed mirror copies of both files to the task's branch as the durable record, and checkpointed the task to `status=pending_review` with the Resend message id as evidence.
